final: WITH c AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), s AS (SELECT CustomerId, spent, spent * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(spent) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
